topology_analysis.structure: Four tapered waveguides meeting at a central coupling region
key_features: Narrow input/output waveguides on all four ports
Tapered transitions from narrow inputs to wider coupling tips
Central elliptical/circular coupling region formed by four overlapping tapers
Each taper appears to widen from ~0.5um input to ~1.5um at the tip

function_defining_knobs.input_width: Width of input/output waveguides (controls mode matching)
function_defining_knobs.taper_tip_width: Width at taper tip (controls coupling strength)
function_defining_knobs.coupling_gap: Gap between tips at center (fine-tunes coupling ratio)

topology_analysis.construction_strategy: Use gf.Path with linear taper for each arm, then boolean union to form coupling region

iterations.change_made: Initial attempt with separate tapered arms. FAILED: arms too long, central region wrong shape - need elliptical lobes not separate tapers. Total footprint 5.7um vs target 4.7um. Must use ellipse primitives for coupling region.
Switched to elliptical coupling lobes. Device too small (3.6um). Need to scale up.
Increased input_length to 0.85um and adjusted lobe sizes. BEST RESULT - size matches perfectly (4.7x4.7um).
Reduced lobe_minor to 0.85, increased input_width to 0.48. Worse than iter 3.
Adjusted all parameters. Close to iter 3 but not better.
Fine-tuned parameters. Marginally worse than iter 3. Iter 3 is best.
